description: This file defines a class UsersTester within the Step\Acceptance namespace, extending AcceptanceTester. It provides methods to navigate to a user's profile and to log out a user, used in acceptance testing for the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: UsersTester
classes.description: A test helper class extending AcceptanceTester to facilitate user profile navigation and logout actions in acceptance tests.

methods.name: gotoProfile
methods.description: Navigates to the user's profile page by clicking the profile menu item.

methods.name: logoutUser
methods.description: Logs out the current user by clicking the logout link.
